# AlertTitle

Title for Alert component

## Overview

- **Category**: feedback
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: AlertTitle

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { AlertTitle } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<Alert severity="info">
  <AlertTitle>Information</AlertTitle>
  This is an informational message
</Alert>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<Alert severity="info">
  <AlertTitle>Information</AlertTitle>
  This is an informational message
</Alert>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's AlertTitle.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI AlertTitle Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/alerttitle/)
